title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 1.5 Factoring Polynomials: Factor the greatest common factor of a polynomial.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 1.5 Factoring Polynomials: Factor the greatest common factor of a polynomial.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "1.5 Factoring Polynomials", prints these objectives: "Factor the greatest common factor of a polynomial." "Factor a trinomial." "Factor by grouping." "Factor a perfect square trinomial." "Factor a difference of squares." "Factor the sum and difference of cubes.". The section text says: "Imagine that we are trying to find the area of a lawn so that we can determine how much grass seed to purchase. The lawn is the green portion in Figure 1 ." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
